title: notes@v0
description: A session's notes.yaml, appended at every choice and surprise. additionalProperties is open throughout: packages/debrief/src/notes.ts reads only the fields it recognizes and never rejects an extra one, and real files in this repository's history carry extra top-level keys (graph, open) and an extra field on a surprise entry (mattered_because) that the reader silently ignores. A choice's rejected is left untyped when present for the same reason, plus one more: a YAML folded scalar (a real pattern in this repository's own history) can parse to a plain string instead of a list, and the reader drops it rather than refusing the file. The ledger's own event-embedded note is the stricter shape, since it is always constructed in code from the fields the reader did keep, never hand-typed.
